lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents on July 1, 2025 (Statistics Canada estimate) per km² of land in the census division that covers most of the hex (2021 Census land area). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Population change
lenses.description: Population change from July 1, 2021 to July 1, 2025 (Statistics Canada estimates on 2021 boundaries) in the census division that covers most of the hex. A change beyond ±25% would be left blank, as in the U.S. edition. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Income
lenses.description: Median total income of households in 2020 in the census division that covers most of the hex (2021 Census, table 98-10-0057). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Low income
lenses.unit: share of people in low income (LIM-AT)
lenses.description: Share of people in private households below the low-income measure after tax in 2020 (2021 Census, table 98-10-0103). Canada's census has no single poverty line; LIM-AT is its standard low-income measure. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Median age
lenses.description: Median age of the census division's residents in 2021 (table 98-10-0022). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Born abroad
lenses.unit: share of residents who are immigrants or non-permanent residents
lenses.description: Immigrants and non-permanent residents ÷ residents of private households, in the census division that covers most of the hex (2021 Census, table 98-10-0348). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Degrees
lenses.unit: adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher
lenses.description: Share of adults aged 25 and over whose highest degree is a bachelor's or higher (2021 Census, table 98-10-0387, ages 25–64 plus 65 and over). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Commute
lenses.unit: average minutes to work, one way
lenses.description: Average one-way commuting time of workers who commute (2021 Census, table 98-10-0458). The census week, in May 2021, fell during COVID-19 restrictions, when many people worked from home. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Homeowners
lenses.description: Owner households ÷ all private households (2021 Census, table 98-10-0259). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land samples in needleleaf, broadleaf or mixed forest (NRCan 2020 land cover, 7 samples per hex). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land samples in cropland, which in NRCan's 2020 land cover includes hay and pasture (7 samples per hex). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land samples in urban and built-up land (NRCan 2020 land cover, 7 samples per hex). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Faith
lenses.note: Self-identified religion of residents in private households (2021 Census), not congregation membership as in the U.S. edition.
lenses.description: Residents who report a religion, per 100 residents of private households, in the census division that covers most of the hex (2021 Census, table 98-10-0354). Religion is self-identified; the U.S. edition counts congregations' adherents instead.

lenses.name: Largest tradition
lenses.note: Self-identified religion of residents in private households (2021 Census), not congregation membership as in the U.S. edition.

categories.name: Protestant & other Christian
categories.description: Every other Christian group: United Church, Anglican, Baptist, Pentecostal, Orthodox, Christian not otherwise stated and more.

lenses.description: The religious tradition most people in the census division report, Catholic and other Christian counted apart (2021 Census, table 98-10-0354).
